svg.title: Pipeline: depth-based and lineage-based analysis
svg.text: Pipeline — configuration → shared runtime → depth-based / lineage-based analysis
python -m src {depth | lineage} · precedence: CLI flags > .env (models only) > config.toml > built-in DEFAULTS (src/config.py)
selected with --env-file; keys never written to manifests
LINUX_BENCHMARK_LOCK env selects the benchmark lock
merge DEFAULTS ← config.toml ← .env roles ← CLI · validate enums / ranges (ConfigError) · readiness checks per mode (check_ready_for_run, check_ready_for_lineage; skipped model checks under replay)
plugin registry: every pluggable part is a built-in short name or "pkg.mod:Class" · resolved config written with secrets redacted (--print-config prints it and exits)
[plugins] language = module test_runner = module:Class feedback = module:Class [depth] selector = "depth" | module:Class [agent] generator = "minisweagent" | module:Class
SHARED RUNTIME — used by both modes
step runs with --network none; named containers
agent-c: LLVM 21, SVF, clang AST, gcc, agent
agent-rust: stable, RUPTA nightly, MIR driver
both keys always written; format errors cached
replay: never calls a model, --network none,
miss → CacheMiss, reported as a session failure
cached: call graph, locate, baseline, verify,
[depth] language = c | rust input = file or project dir (--language --input)
images exist (IDs recorded) · git commit · tool versions
build original + run visible and hidden suites concurrently; any failure → abort
BFS depth from entry main; Rust generic instances deduplicated (min depth)
[depth] depth = D | unset (all) rule = eq | le | ge include_unreachable = false
order = shallow_first | deep_first | source | random seed = 0
Rust free fns, inherent + trait methods, generics, unsafe/async; main excluded
computed once from the original program (--dry-run stops here)
independent: every function diversified concurrently against the original
cumulative: waves of N functions diversified against the same snapshot,
C: clang -ast-dump=json · Rust: rustc_private item driver (rs_items.rs)
writes a function file holding just the function (methods in a stub impl)
D6b Agent session (shared runtime; project read-only, hidden suite never mounted)
agent edits only the function file; may read the whole project
tool `agent-test`: splice → signature check → additions check → build → visible suite
D6c Controller re-verification (never trusts the agent)
harvest only the function file → re-splice, compiler-based signature check
(name, params, return, qualifiers; Rust generics/lifetimes/where/vis/abi) → build → visible
hidden suite in an isolated container;
D6 Per selected function (N in parallel, one container + session each)
stop reasons: success · loop_limit · no_progress · timeout · budget_exhausted · agent_execution_failure · infrastructure_failure
apply accepted candidates in selection order onto the evolving program:
re-locate the function → re-splice → re-verify (build + visible suite)
conflict / failure → one "rebase" re-diversification against the merged program
visible + hidden suites on final/ (or each variant) concurrently
summary.json (parallel, elapsed_s, cache hits/misses, merge, rebased)
source language → image: rust → agent-rust, C/Python → agent-c
benchmark images (oracle, compiler, rust compiler) checked against the lock
aider: host Aider exactly as before
--remote-base-url + key via env (AGENT_LINEAGE_API_KEY), never on argv
one script process per lineage; starts staggered until the log shows
checkpoints 000, 001, … : prompts/<lang>/NNN_*.md, bundle of tests/ + judges/<lang>.sh
minisweagent shim: copy workdir → /work in a fresh agent-c/agent-rust container;
run the topology (shared runtime) with the stage / repair prompt
agent wall time = max(t/2, t-120); SIGTERM / timeout still harvests source
copy back ONLY the editable source; other changes discarded; prints
L4c Build + checkpoint judge (Docker, compiler/oracle images)
compile candidate → judge against the stage tests (src/harness/docker_benchmark.py)
failures rendered into the next prompt
exhausted → lineage stops at this stage
L4 src/harness/run_lineage_experiment.sh → run_experiment.sh per lineage × checkpoint × attempt
stop reasons: success · loop_limit · no_progress · agent_execution_failure · infrastructure_failure · repair_prompt_failed
aider_version = minisweagent-shim …, sampling, model_provenance per lineage
state, checkpoints_completed, failure_stage, failure_reason per lineage
Rerun without an LLM (testing pipeline changes cheaply)
python -m src depth --replay … python -m src lineage --replay … (same [cache] dir; namespace selects which recorded samples)
model responses come from the LLM cache (sequence match follows recorded actions even if observations change); deterministic steps whose inputs and code_hash
are unchanged come from the step cache; anything touched by the code change recomputes. Measured on the C toy: real run 318 s → replay 13.6 s cold / 6.3 s warm.
monospace teal = config key (TOML / env / flag) with default
